title: Likely flaky: the US-16 AC2d upload review's Save test failed once on CI on a PR that touched no widget code
evidence: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.erase-commit.test.tsx, the US-16 AC2d case for the upload review's Save, failed with AssertionError: expected false to be true on CI run https://github.com/DrBradStanfield/roadmap/actions/runs/43141897972 (unit (1, UTC)) for PR 1372 (head 77bda5ea1), which changed no widget code.
